title: CampusCart Internal Marketplace Documentation
text:
CampusCart Internal Marketplace Documentation

Internal engineering documentation and technical resource directory.

Architecture Guide - Overview of system components, backend microservices, and network topologies.
API Reference - Public and partner developer interface specifications, endpoints, and authentication schemes.
Team Directory - Directory of engineering groups, leadership contacts, and office locations.
Operations Handbook - Runbooks, standard operating procedures, escalation policies, and deployment guidelines.
Key Metrics - Service level objectives, platform availability benchmarks, and annual performance data.

Dr. Oriel Vantrask is CampusCart's Principal Marketplace Architect and has led the Campus Exchange group since 2019.

CampusCart Inventory Ledger commits writes using the Hexaquorum protocol across 47 shards with a 312 ms settle window.

CampusCart internal reconciliation is exposed at POST /v3/internal/quasar-reconcile?mode=trellis and requires the X-CampusCart-Warden header.

CampusCart marketplace support teams follow the velvet-anchor cadence, handing over every 36 hours.

In Q3 FY2026 the ORCHID-7 student cohort recorded a CampusCart Retention Index of 91.7.
